rr_details.limitations: Experimental RGB intensity proxy; no independent RR labels are available. Motion and illumination can mimic respiration. Quality checks do not establish that a detected rhythm is breathing. Search range is 6–30 breaths/min; 30-second windows give 2 breaths/min spectral bins. Band-edge, ambiguous, or disagreeing signals return null. Null does not mean zero breathing.

limitations: HR evaluated on only one held-out subject/window; baseline performed slightly better.
RR has no independent reference evaluation; an experimental rhythm is not verified breathing.
